title: Conceptual Model for the Hepatocellular Carcinoma Screening Continuum: Current Status and Research Agenda

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Conceptual Model for the Hepatocellular Carcinoma Screening Continuum: Current Status and Research Agenda》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) continues to have a dismal prognosis, with 5-year survival below 20%.

evidence.text: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) continues to have a dismal prognosis, with 5-year survival below 20%.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Conceptual Model for the Hepatocellular Carcinoma Screening Continuum: Current Status and Research Agenda》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】This poor prognosis can be in part attributed to failures along the cancer screening process continuum such as underuse of screening in at risk patients and appropriate treatments for patients with HCC.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】The conceptual model illustrates how each step in the screening process is prone to delays or failure, resulting in worse outcomes such as late stage diagnosis or poor survival, and how factors at the patient, provider, and health care system levels can contribute to these failures.
